1) Menthol cigarette advertising and price promotions are common in the retail environment, particularly among Black residents and low income areas, 2) Menthol cigarette prices are cheaper among Black residents and areas with low incomes, 3) Menthol cigarette marketing is more common among Black residents and lower income areas, and 4) Price promotions for Newport are more common among areas with more Black population.
